LanguageData.RSW_Cuisine_SettingsNeedsColdStorage: Needs Cold Storage. Applies at once.
LanguageData.RSW_Cuisine_SettingCarbonPressDesc: Off: the press leaves the build menu and its bills stop. Built presses and packs stay; packs keep their food.
LanguageData.RSW_Cuisine_SettingCarbonShockDesc: Each meal thawed out of a carbonite pack may come out carbon-burnt: edible, tastes of metal, a small bad thought. Raw food never burns.
